name: regenerateShield
signature: export function regenerateShield(effect: Extract<ExtendedEffect, { do: 'regenerate' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 701.15a the next time this permanent would be destroyed, instead tap it, remove it from combat and heal all damage
layerOrTiming: resolution; the shield is consumed by a later destruction event, until end of turn
contract: Regeneration is a SHIELD, not a prevention and not an indestructible grant. It is placed now and consumed later, so this primitive creates the shield and does not itself stop anything.

The shield is expressed as a counter on the permanent, because GameState has a per-card counter map and no shield list. The counter name is fixed and namespaced so it can never collide with a printed counter type.
One CARD_COUNTER per affected permanent, delta equal to the evaluated count.
A permanent that is not on the battlefield gets no shield.
It must NOT emit SET_KEYWORD indestructible: a regeneration shield is used up, and indestructible is not.

evidence.claim: regeneration is a counted shield, not a boolean flag
the shield lasts until end of turn

assertions.expect: one CARD_COUNTER with the namespaced shield counter, delta 1
delta 2 on one action, not two actions of 1

assertions.given: a target that has left the battlefield

assertions.expect: no SET_KEYWORD action is ever emitted

unlocks.source: docs/overhaul/PRIMITIVE-BUILD-ORDER.md rank 29, 33 new cards in the XMage ranking. NOT measured against our own catalogue: the compiler has no regenerate rule, so it is not in either of our two measured tables.
